clauses.quote: The WTU and DCPS agree to collaborate on the conversion of EG classification bargaining unit members to ET classification immediately following the effective date of implementation of this Agreement.
clauses.notes: Joint contractual duty; acting_party is 'other' per instructions.

clauses.quote: Only in situations where such conversions can be made without negative impact or harm to the affected Teacher, DCPS and the WTU agree to make the conversions.

When any such personnel are serving in any capacity other than in the EG 09 job classifications above, the WTU will not represent them in that capacity unless such job classification has a community of interest with the WTU bargaining unit.
clauses.notes: Scope of representation limitation restricting union duties.
